Vice President, Software Engineering — Seven Bridges

Location: Remote. US preferred. India or EMEA candidates considered.

Reports to: Chief Technology Officer

Who are we?

Velsera is the precision engine company. We build the software researchers, scientists, and clinicians use to drive precision R&D and bring analytics closer to the point of care. Seven Bridges, Pierian, and UgenTec came together to form Velsera; we are headquartered in Boston, MA, with [current headcount] colleagues across [current country count] countries.

The Seven Bridges Platform is our research genomics platform — roughly 130 containerized services, multi-cloud, running in commercial and FedRAMP Moderate environments, where scientists run CWL, WDL, and Nextflow workflows over petabyte-scale genomic data. Current priorities are federated data management, compliance as a product capability, and governed AI.

Reporting line and scope

You report to the CTO and own engineering for the Seven Bridges Platform: architecture, delivery, and production operations, including reliability, cost, technical debt, and observability. The team is primarily in India, with a smaller group in Serbia; you lead across both sites and work daily with stakeholders in other time zones. You hold architecture authority for the platform, co-own boundary decisions with security, federal compliance, and quality leadership, and partner with a cross-business AI Engineering team.

The role is roughly 40% hands-on technical work and 60% people leadership and organizational delivery. Hands-on means owning architecture decisions of record, leading design reviews, reviewing code and infrastructure changes, and prototyping where needed. You should be credible to your most senior engineers, with a clear view of what this class of platform should become and the ability to take a team and a business there.

What will you do?

  • Own the technical vision for the platform over the next three years, and turn it into an architecture and roadmap the team and the business believe in.
  • Own architecture decisions of record, design reviews, multi-tenant isolation, and complexity reduction across the service estate.
  • Keep delivery governed and modern: infrastructure-as-code under CI with policy-as-code, short-lived credentials, progressive rollout, and change evidence that holds up to audit in a federally authorized environment.
  • Own reliability: SLOs and error budgets on the paths customers depend on, on-call design that works across two sites, and turning repeat incidents into architectural change.
  • Ship governed AI in the product and apply AI to how the team builds, both under a governance policy co-owned with Risk & Compliance, and both measured.
  • Build the team: management depth you can trust with delivery, the specialist skills the roadmap needs, and maintaining a thriving team through a period of growth.

Requirements

What do you bring to the table?

Must have

  1. 12+ years in software engineering, including several years leading multi-team organizations through managers.
  1. Distributed-systems and platform architecture ownership at scale — multi-tenant isolation, service decomposition, and the judgment to reduce complexity.
  1. Domain depth in scientific or biomedical data platforms — genomics, bioinformatics, life sciences, or comparable data-intensive, workflow-driven scientific computing.
  1. Delivery inside a regulatory boundary such as FedRAMP, HIPAA, ISO 13485, or GxP.
  1. Reliability and modern delivery engineering: SLOs, error budgets, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD with policy-as-code and progressive rollout.
  1. Production AI/LLM capability shipped under a compliance regime, or AI-assisted engineering you landed, governed and measured — beyond pilots.
  1. A track record of setting technical vision for a platform and carrying an organization there.
  1. Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • CWL/WDL/Nextflow, GA4GH standards (DRS/WES), FHIR or OMOP.
  • Federated or cross-institutional data access at scale — bringing analysis to data held by someone else.
  • Federal program delivery and artifact literacy — authorization packages, significant-change requests, and corrective-action plans.
  • Architecture depth in inference topology: hosting trade-offs, retrieval that inherits per-tenant authorization, evaluation harnesses, and guardrails.
  • Shipping reusable product capability out of grant- or program-funded work.

Competences

Vision

The ability to step back from the daily routine, explore ideas for the future, and see the platform in a broader context and in the longer term.

  • articulates where the platform must be in three years, and why
  • combines scientific, regulatory, and technology trends into one coherent direction
  • spots opportunities for the platform early and acts on them

Technical Depth

Personal command of the technology the platform is built on, enough to shape and challenge its biggest decisions.

  • reads code, designs, and test results first-hand rather than relying on summaries
  • changes a team’s technical direction with evidence rather than authority
  • is treated as a peer by senior engineers in design review

Managing

The ability to lead and develop others so they perform at their best — setting direction, providing the means, and holding the bar.

  • builds a management layer capable of running delivery without them, then holds it accountable
  • makes hiring and performance decisions promptly and explains them plainly
  • builds confidence and momentum and creates a thriving team environment

Focus on Quality

Setting high standards and treating quality, security, and compliance as design constraints rather than gates to be cleared.

  • designs for auditability, traceability, and reproducibility from the outset
  • converts recurring incidents into architectural and process change
  • declines shortcuts that would trade a compliance position for a delivery date

Decision Quality Under Ambiguity

The ability to make timely, defensible decisions on incomplete information, and to revisit them when the evidence changes.

  • commits to a sequence when the data is partial, and states what would change their mind
  • separates reversible from irreversible decisions and spends attention accordingly
  • records the reasoning as well as the outcome

Benefits

Our core values

People first. We create collaborative and supportive environments by operating with respect and flexibility to promote mental, emotional and physical health. We practice empathy by treating others the way they want to be treated and assuming positive intent. We are proud of our inclusive diverse team and humble ourselves to learn about and build our connection with each other.

Patient focused. We act with swift determination without sacrificing our expectations of quality. We are driven by providing exceptional solutions for our customers to positively impact patient lives. Considering what is at stake, we challenge ourselves to develop the best solution, not just the easy one.

Integrity. We hold ourselves accountable and strive for transparent communication to build trust amongst ourselves and our customers. We take ownership of our results as we know what we do matters and collectively we will change the healthcare industry. WHO WE ARE

EnableComp earned its reputation in the toughest corners of the revenue cycle by solving the complex claims no one else could. We developed Complex Revenue Intelligence™ (CRI), a smarter approach to predict and prevent revenue loss. Powered by the e360 RCM® AI-driven platform and the most expansive complex revenue cycle data set, today EnableComp helps more than 1,000 hospitals nationwide recover $3 billion annually from complex claims, denials, and revenue recovery. By cutting through complexity, we help hospitals thrive, resulting in recognition as Black Book’s #1 Specialty RCM provider for complex claims and revenue integrity in 2024 and 2025, a multi-year Top Workplaces honoree, and a SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST e1-certified platform.Our Vision is to empower healthcare providers to focus on patient care, not revenue cycle complexity. Our Mission is to uncover what others miss—turning every client dollar recovered into insight that helps prevent future loss. We live our Core Values of Uncompromising Integrity, Ecstatic Clients, and Empowered Team Members by operating with trust, accountability, and a “we before me” mindset. We pursue Innovation and Profitable Growth through continuous improvement and thoughtful problem-solving, and we believe work should include Fun—celebrating success, recognizing our people, and maintaining healthy work-life balance.

POSITION SUMMARY

The GTM Sales Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and operating the technical infrastructure that powers EnableComp's account-based demand generation motion. This role sits at the intersection of Revenue Operations and Marketing, translating buying signals, catalysts, and triggers (M&A activity, leadership changes, RCM technology contract expirations, RFP activity, hiring patterns, and other intent data) into prioritized, enriched, and routed target accounts inside HubSpot. The GTM Engineer owns the tooling, data pipelines, and workflow automation connecting Clay, HubSpot, and other GTM systems, ensuring Marketing and Sales are always working the highest-propensity accounts with accurate, enriched data and minimal manual effort.

The Job Responsibilities Include

  • Build and maintain automated workflows in Clay that identify and score ABM signals, catalysts, and triggers (e.g., executive changes, M&A, technology contract expirations, RFPs, hiring surges) across target health system and physician group accounts.
  • Partner with Marketing and Revenue Operations to design and maintain the HubSpot architecture (lists, workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, and routing rules) that operationalizes signal-based account prioritization.
  • Develop and maintain integrations and data pipelines between Clay, HubSpot, enrichment/intent data providers, and internal systems (e.g., CRM, data warehouse) using APIs, webhooks, and native connectors.
  • Analyze account and contact-level data to identify patterns in signal quality, conversion, and pipeline impact, refining scoring models and enrichment logic accordingly.
  • Lead the technical build-out of net-new ABM campaigns, ensuring signal capture, enrichment, and routing logic are in place before launch.
  • Conduct regular audits of data quality, deduplication, and enrichment accuracy across HubSpot and Clay to maintain a clean, reliable source of truth for GTM teams.
  • Coordinate with Sales Development, Partnerships, and Client Services to ensure signal-qualified accounts are routed to the right owner with appropriate context and timing.
  • Evaluate new GTM tools, data providers, and automation opportunities that could improve signal detection, targeting precision, or operational efficiency.
  • Identify gaps or bottlenecks in the demand generation tech stack and workflows, and design scalable solutions in partnership with Marketing and RevOps leadership.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Education Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field required; equivalent practical experience considered
  • 3+ years of experience in a GTM Engineering, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales Operations role, ideally within B2B SaaS or healthcare technology
  • Demonstrated hands-on expertise administering HubSpot (workflows, lists, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, reporting) in a marketing or revenue operations capacity
  • Direct experience building enrichment and signal-detection workflows in Clay, including use of formulas, integrations, and waterfall enrichment
  • Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, and no-code/low-code automation tools (e.g., Zapier, Make) to connect GTM systems
  • Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) concepts, intent data providers, and B2B enterprise buying committees
  • Strong SQL or spreadsheet-based data analysis skills; comfort working with large, imperfect data sets
  • Timely and regular attendance.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered
  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Special Considerations & Prerequisites

  • Minimal travel required (less than 20%), primarily for occasional team or company offsites
  • Ability to work at a computer for extended periods; standard office or remote work environment
  • A great candidate is self-directed and comfortable owning ambiguous, cross-functional problems; treats data hygiene as non-negotiable; and can translate technical workflows into plain-language impact for Sales and Marketing stakeholders
  • Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission.

We believe that investing in our employees is the key to our success, and we are dedicated to providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive and grow their career here. At EnableComp, we are committed to living up to our core values each and every day, and we believe that this commitment is what sets us apart from other companies. If you are looking for a company that values its employees and is dedicated to helping them achieve their full potential, then EnableComp is the place for you.

Travel Leaders Network gives their members everything they need to grow as a Leader and inspire more people to travel better.

Responsibilities

The Manager of Application Development owns the engineering team’s execution and the technical health, security, PCI compliance, and operational reliability of AgentMate, while partnering with Product and Delivery on approved priorities.

This is a hands-on management role for an experienced senior .NET engineer who can manage and mentor developers while remaining close to the code. The manager will translate business priorities into reliable software, help guide technical decisions, improve engineering discipline, and partner with product, delivery, infrastructure, security, and business teams to deliver secure, scalable, user-focused solutions.

A primary focus of this role is to ensure that AgentMate is secure, compliant, reliable, maintainable, and operationally sound, with particular emphasis on PCI requirements, application security, vulnerability management, secure development practices, access controls, data protection, and remediation of security risks.

The manager works closely with Information Security, Infrastructure, QA, Product, Delivery, and business stakeholders to ensure development activities meet established security, compliance, architectural, quality, and operational standards. The role supports product and business priorities from an engineering perspective but is not the primary owner of product strategy or roadmap direction.

Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop the AgentMate application development team, setting clear expectations for delivery, quality, security, collaboration, and accountability.
  • Plan and prioritize team capacity in partnership with product and delivery leaders; manage competing priorities, dependencies, production needs, and technical debt.
  • Conduct regular one-on-ones, provide timely feedback, support career development, and build succession and knowledge-sharing practices.
  • Create an inclusive, pragmatic engineering culture that values ownership, transparency, continuous learning, and measurable improvement.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, performance management, and resource planning for the application development team.

Hands-On Application Development

  • Remain actively involved in solution design, coding, code review, troubleshooting, and delivery for business-critical AgentMate capabilities.
  • Design, build, test, and maintain modern applications and services using C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, SQL, and Azure-aligned services.
  • Guide the development of responsive, accessible user experiences using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Promote maintainable engineering patterns, appropriate reuse, automated testing, clear documentation, and clean deployment practices.
  • Diagnose complex application issues across front-end, API, service, database, integration, and hosting layers.

Application Security and Risk Management

  • Embed secure software development practices throughout requirements, design, coding, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Lead application threat modeling, secure design reviews, security-focused code reviews, and remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
  • Apply practical knowledge of OWASP application security risks, authentication and authorization, identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, dependency risk, input validation, and secure API design.
  • Partner with Information Security and infrastructure teams on vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, incident response, audit support, and security control adoption.
  • Ensure applications, libraries, and third-party components are inventoried, monitored, patched, and upgraded in a risk-based and timely manner.
  • Coach developers on defensive coding and make security expectations part of the team’s definition of done.

Delivery, Quality, and Operations

  • Own engineering execution from technical discovery through production release and ongoing support, with clear visibility into risks, decisions, and progress.
  • Improve software quality through unit, integration, regression, performance, and security testing, with automation wherever practical.
  • Establish effective code review, branching, build, deployment, release, and rollback practices within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Improve application observability through actionable logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for significant defects or incidents and ensure durable corrective actions are completed.
  • Balance new feature delivery with modernization, reliability, maintainability, and reduction of technical debt.

Technical Direction and Collaboration

  • Provide technical direction for the AgentMate application while operating within established enterprise architecture, security, infrastructure, and technology standards.
  • Work closely with product owners, delivery managers, architects, security partners, QA, operations, and business stakeholders to shape feasible solutions and delivery plans.
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Maintain current application, integration, data-flow, deployment, and support documentation sufficient for operational continuity.
  • Evaluate new technologies and patterns based on business value, security, supportability, cost, and team readiness rather than novelty.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of professional application development experience, including substantial hands-on experience with Microsoft .NET technologies.
  • 2+ years of formal people leadership, engineering management, team lead, or comparable experience with responsibility for coaching and delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency with C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, SQL, object-oriented design, asynchronous programming, and modern testing practices.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and supporting modern web applications with React and TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Demonstrated application security experience, including secure coding, threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, authentication/authorization, OWASP risks, dependency management, and secure API practices.
  • Experience with cloud-hosted applications and services, preferably Microsoft Azure, including CI/CD, monitoring, secrets/configuration management, and production support.
  • Experience integrating applications with internal and third-party services using APIs, messaging, and scheduled or event-driven processing.
  • Proven ability to lead technical delivery, make sound tradeoffs, manage risk, and communicate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Willingness and ability to contribute directly to code, design, reviews, and incident resolution as team needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience modernizing legacy .NET applications or decomposing tightly coupled systems in an incremental, low-risk manner.
  • PCI Professional (PCIP), Security+, CISSP, CSSLP, or comparable security certification.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS requirements and the application-development responsibilities associated with PCI compliance.
  • Experience with Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Azure SQL, API Management, Key Vault, Application Insights, or comparable services.
  • Experience with identity platforms and standards such as Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, and role-based access control.
  • Experience with software composition analysis, static and dynamic application security testing, secrets scanning, and remediation workflows.
  • Familiarity with performance engineering, caching, resiliency patterns, distributed systems, and production observability.
  • Experience in travel technology, CRM, member-facing platforms, or systems involving complex third-party integrations.

PAY AND BENEFITS

Our benefit offerings include choice of two medical plans and two dental plans, vision insurance, flexible spending accounts (FSAs), company-paid life insurance and AD&D, optional additional life insurance and AD&D, disability insurance, paid parental leave, paid time off, 401k Plan with company match, discounted employee travel options, access to LinkedIn Learning webinars and courses. Discounted pet insurance and auto, home, & renters insurance.

Many factors, such as years of experience, geographical location, budget etc. are considered when determining the starting rate of pay. The salary range posted represents the pay range for U.S. candidates. If the job posting indicates that the role is available for international candidate consideration, the salary range will be based on the local market for the country where the candidate would be working.

This role may be eligible for an incentive, commission, bonus, or a discretionary bonus program based on the company’s financial goal achievement and individual performance.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

Schedule

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8am to 5pm or from 9am to 6pm in your local time zone.

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct outbound telephonic patient outreach and provide one-on-one coaching and support to patients managing chronic conditions, including but not limited to type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.
  • Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.
  • Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.
  • Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.
  • Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.
  • Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways.
  • Collaborate in real time with clinicians and patient support teams using tools such as our Cadence Platform, Google Workspace, and Slack, and contribute feedback to improve workflows in a fast-moving, change-oriented environment.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

Who You Are

  • A clinician who thrives at the intersection of rigorous care standards and a care delivery model that is still being built.
  • Skilled in patient education, coaching, and care coordination - you meet patients where they are in life, considering their age, lifestyle, and diet.
  • Disciplined in documentation and follow-through, with the attention to detail required for accurate clinical records in a remote environment.
  • Reliable and consistent in schedule adherence, with the interpersonal communication skills to build trust with patients over the phone.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with evolving workflows, and tech-savvy enough to navigate and troubleshoot multiple systems simultaneously while keeping patients engaged.
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini or Open Evidence) to support patient interactions and surface relevant clinical context, while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision.
  • Biased toward action - you bring clinical authority to every interaction, make the call when it counts, and take ownership of outcomes.

What You Need

  • An active compact multi-state LPN/LVN license in the state where you currently reside is required.
  • At least 5 years of clinical experience as a Licensed Practical Nurse is required.
  • Remote work readiness (including stable high-speed WiFi) is required.
  • An active CA state LVN license is highly preferred.
  • Fluency in Spanish is required.
  • Experience providing patient education and support to individuals managing chronic conditions is preferred.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini, Open Evidence, or comparable platforms) and the ability to speak credibly with providers and patients about where AI supports care delivery and where human judgment remains non-negotiable.

CatalyzeX is a business process outsourcing specialist that combines process expertise with top offshore talent, delivering the best value outcomes for its clients. We are currently expanding our team to support a high-growth client in the software and AI space serving the heavy equipment industry.

Who You Are

We're looking for a driven Sales Development Representative (SDR) who thrives on creating meaningful first impressions, identifying high-potential opportunities, and setting the stage for successful customer relationships. You're comfortable reaching out to new prospects, re-engaging warm leads, and nurturing conversations that open doors to revenue.

You have the ability to listen actively, ask the right questions, and confidently guide prospects through the early stages of the sales funnel. This is a high call volume outbound role — success here requires energy, resilience, and a genuine interest in connecting with people. Persistence, professionalism, and a results-oriented mindset are the keys to success in this role.

Integrity is non-negotiable. We represent best-in-class products — getting a demo booked should be achievable without exaggeration. We're looking for agents who earn demos honestly and represent the product with confidence.

Qualifications

  • 1+ year of experience in sales development, cold calling, telemarketing, or inside sales (preferred).

  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing leads and follow-ups through CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).

  • Familiarity with the heavy equipment industry (dealerships, trucks, machinery) is a plus.

What You'll Do

raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is beloved by developers for the simplicity of our APIs, the thoroughness of our documentation, and our focus on developer experience. The Technical Solutions Engineering (TSE) team is the glue that supports our developer-users and champions developer experience as being central to the overall experience of our users. TSE interacts directly with developer-users more than any other team at Stripe, so your role will have a significant impact on what Stripe is known for and values most. When we do our job well, developers all over the world are able to smoothly launch and grow their businesses on Stripe, whether they’re integrating payments for the first time or building complex financial systems.

What you’ll do

TSEs understand the fundamentals of programming incredibly well and eagerly jump in and familiarize themselves with others’ code. You will do a wide variety of things, including explaining technical concepts about Stripe’s products, build and debug integrations with developers, and produce/improve guides that help our users solve particular problems to be successful with Stripe. You will interact with developers of all skill levels through a variety of mediums, enabling them to be successful when using Stripe.

Early on, current team members will devote a large amount of time to teaching you and helping you get to a level of comfort and expertise with Stripe, its services, and how we interact with users. Later, we’d love for you to take on this role with others on the team and Stripes broadly, as teaching is a great way to learn and to reinforce what you know.

If you’re someone who enjoys working with all kinds of code, is a fast researcher, a strong writer, and enthusiastic about helping others build mission-critical products with Stripe, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Communicate with a number of external developers and aid them in building their applications against Stripe’s infrastructure in a number of programming languages (including Java, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, NodeJS, .NET, ReactJS, React Native, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, and Java for Android).
  • Unblock external developers with their thorniest integration challenges through a variety of support channels including email, ticketing software, internal issue trackers, community platforms (like StackOverflow), and real-time chat software (like Slack and Discord)
  • Develop and maintain internal and external documentation, examples, integration demos, and code-snippets that demonstrate usage patterns of the Stripe infrastructure.
  • Identify points of friction developers encounter and collaborate with engineering teams to make Stripe products better. Participate in a number of extended engineering teams’ regular planning sessions, design reviews, and development meetings.
  • Develop and maintain a suite of internal support tooling for TSE and Stripe Support more broadly e.g. a retrieval augmented generation LLM-based Copilot tool or the Invoice Explainer Admin tool.
  • Act as a developer advocate and educational resource internal to the organization by regularly assembling training for non-developers internal to the organization and responding in real-time to product integration questions.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

This role is remote but requires candidates to be located in the Mountain or Pacific time zones.

Minimum requirements

  • At least 4 years of full-stack software development experience, with a proven track record of building web or mobile applications that deliver high-quality user experiences
  • Direct experience explaining technical concepts, and would be comfortable explaining how Stripe works to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Understands how to write good, clean code in multiple programming languages, as well as how to read code that might not be quite as well written
  • Ability to help users during working hours in the region you are in. This may occasionally include providing weekend coverage for monitoring/supporting critical infrastructure, which TSEs are uniquely equipped to assist with given the team’s knowledge around Stripe’s products and active integrations. The team is largely remote, and we are very supportive of working arrangements that allow for family care and other needs to be met.

Preferred qualifications

  • Enjoys writing in a clear and quick manner
  • General software engineering skills are important to us, as we understand that new languages and frameworks can be learned if you understand the concepts
  • Experience teaching or coaching developers
  • Comfort working with a great deal of autonomy and limited supervision
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software/Computer Engineering, or a related analytical field of study

Job Summary

The Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) is seeking experienced candidates for a Data Analyst IV - Advanced Analytics & Reporting position within Access & Eligibility Services (AES), Data Management & Reporting team. The position supports HHSC’s mission to connect Texans to essential services by delivering advanced analytics, ensuring data quality, and providing operational decision support to internal teams.

Data Analyst IV functions as a senior individual contributor and hybrid analyst/mentor. The role performs complex analytical work under minimal supervision, applies independent judgment, mentors and reviews the work of other analysts, and delivers clear, actionable insights to non‑technical stakeholders. These positions do not have formal supervisory authority.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

Advanced Analytics & Insight Generation (30%)

  • Performs advanced SQL analysis to identify trends, patterns, and performance drivers.
  • Develops predictive and trend analyses to support operational planning and proactive decision‑making.
  • Translates complex analyses into clear findings and actionable recommendations for internal stakeholders.

Data Quality & Validation (25%)

  • Establishes and documents data quality rules, business definitions, and acceptance criteria.
  • Partners with business and technical teams to resolve data quality issues and prevent recurrence.

Operational Decision Support & Reporting (20%)

  • Provides clear data narratives, briefings, and written summaries in plain language.
  • Implements Power Automate workflows to streamline recurring reporting and operational processes.

Data Pipelines & Performance (15%)

  • Designs, optimizes, and troubleshoots ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple data platforms.
  • Collaborates with peers on data modeling and performance tuning.
  • Contributes to future‑state analytics solutions, including readiness for Databricks adoption.

Mentorship & Peer Review (10%)

  • Mentors and reviews the work of lower‑level data analysts.
  • Shares best practices for SQL, data modeling, validation, visualization, and documentation.
  • Assists with onboarding and skill development for analysts within the team.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs)

  • Skill in advanced proficiency in SQL, including complex queries, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Skills in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, and dashboard development.
  • Skill in designing and supporting ETL/ELT data pipelines.
  • Skill in using Power Automate to support operational workflows.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, validation, reconciliation, and documentation practices.
  • Ability to perform predictive and trend analysis aligned with business needs.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to non‑technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated accuracy, attention to detail, data integrity, curiosity, and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with business analysts, developers, and program staff.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and work effectively with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to perform predictive or trend analysis in an operational or program environment.
  • Knowledge of health and human services or government/public sector settings.
  • Knowledge in working with Snowflake and cross‑platform SQL environments (SQL Server and Oracle).
  • Skilled with R, Python, SPSS, and advanced Excel.

Registrations, Licensure Requirements, or Certifications

  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP‑600) – Preferred
  • Microsoft Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL‑200) – Preferred
  • Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) – Preferred
  • IIBA Certification in Business Data Analytics (CBDA) – Preferred
  • DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) – Preferred

Initial Screening Criteria

  • Two (2) years of professional experience as a data analyst performing advanced SQL analysis, data transformation, advanced reporting (Power BI or Tableau), and data quality validation.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of relevant professional experience.

Additional Information

Apply today to become a Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth Facilitator!

Applications are due: September 4 2026

About The Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth Facilitator Program:

  • Open to all Indigenous youth ages 18-29 who are interested in joining a movement of Indigenous young people leading discussions on mental health and wellbeing through our Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth.
  • Facilitators connect directly with their peers through live sharing circles led by and for Indigenous youth to build foundational mental health literacy, normalize mental health conversations and reduce stigma related to mental health and illness.
  • Participants build foundational skills in group facilitation, public speaking and advocacy through comprehensive training on how to facilitate vital conversations about mental health with their peers in a safe and supportive way.
  • Facilitators receive $250 for completing training and certifying as a Jack Talks for Indigenous Youth Facilitator, and are compensated $50 for each Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth they facilitate, in addition to $50 for the preparation of each talk.
    The time commitment for this program is approximately 2-5 hours a month between September and June, and approximately 4 hours for combined asynchronous and synchronous training once a term.

What is the Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth? Check out this video

The Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth puts community practice front and centre in educating about mental health struggle and healing from Indigenous perspectives. The program uses contact-based education and peer-to-peer outreach to connect Indigenous youth across Canada in conversations about mental health and healing.

A Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth is made up of two parts:

  • a video portion that explains social determinants of mental health from Indigenous perspectives and features youth stories about navigating mental health struggle, experiences with stigma and the relationship between culture, community and mental health
  • a live sharing circle led by an Indigenous Youth Facilitator who guides participants in exploring lessons and reflections, using the video portion as the spark for generating group discussion and connection.

raw.description:
About Us:

Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, Divcon delivers fully integrated automation solutions nationwide that optimize performance, energy efficiency, and reliability across HVAC, lighting, power monitoring, and mission-critical systems. Leveraging advanced technologies - including Allen-Bradley PLCs, Ignition SCADA, and Delta DDC systems - we combine deep technical expertise with field-tested execution to deliver precise, scalable, and high-performance solutions.

About the role:

The Senior Applications Engineer provides advanced technical support, application development, integration, troubleshooting, and quality review for DDC/BMS/BAS control system projects. This role supports complex BAS network configuration, gateway integration, customer-facing technical discussions, portfolio standards, and issue resolution for active and existing sites.

This position requires mature judgment, technical depth, independent problem-solving, and the ability to mentor others while supporting consistent, high-quality department output. The Senior Applications Engineer also performs the core responsibilities of the Applications Engineer role while preparing for broader technical leadership responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

Advanced Technical Application & Integration

  • Troubleshoot and assist with BMS network setup, configuration, connectivity, and related system issues.
  • Create gateway configurations used between Modbus and BACnet networks.
  • Develop and support control system databases, interfaces, programming, and related deliverables for sequences of operation and project requirements.
  • Provide customer-requested changes, updates, and enhancements to existing databases and application files.
  • Support Service Teams with issues on existing sites and older projects, including technical investigation and resolution recommendations.

Technical Leadership & Quality Review

  • Review standards across portfolios and help ensure consistent, high-quality output across assigned work.
  • Attend and provide technical input as needed in customer-facing meetings.
  • Support, coach, and guide Applications Engineers and Associate Application Engineers on technical tasks, documentation, and project workflows.
  • Shadow and collaborate with the Lead Applications Engineer to learn direction, workflow management, and leadership practices.

Project Execution & Department Support

  • Debug installation issues during static and dynamic start-up and commissioning of building controls and special systems.
  • Provide input to sales staff as requested or required to assist in accurate estimation, design, installation, start-up, commissioning, and training for building systems.
  • Communicate technical risks, missing information, status updates, and required decisions to appropriate stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Maintain organized project documentation, revisions, database support materials, and technical notes throughout the project lifecycle.

Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of commercial HVAC, building automation systems (BAS), DDC/BMS controls, and related control sequences.
  • Ability to read and interpret project specifications, sequences of operation, drawings, equipment submittals, and controls documentation.
  • Familiarity with BACnet and Modbus communication protocols and BAS network concepts.
  • Clear understanding of computer and BAS networks, including device addressing, connectivity, and troubleshooting fundamentals.
  • Strong analytical, technical problem-solving, communication, organization, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced project environment while maintaining a high degree of integrity and accountability.
  • Experience with Delta Controls preferred; experience with Reliable Controls, KMC, Siemens, or similar product lines is a plus.
  • Experience with EPMS integration, MSA FieldServer Protonode, Python, JavaScript, or other line-based coding is a plus.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience programming BAS/DDC systems and integrating with third-party equipment preferred.
  • Advanced troubleshooting experience with BAS networks, BACnet, Modbus, gateway configuration, commercial HVAC systems, and commissioning support preferred.
  • Experience with mission-critical sites, data center environments, EPMS integration, Delta Controls, Reliable Controls, KMC, Siemens, or similar product lines strongly preferred.

Benefits & Total Rewards:

  • Opportunities for Growth

Hands-on training and career advancement in an exploding data-center industry.

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

We cover 100% of individual medical premiums and help offset the cost of family coverage.

  • 401K with Employer Match

Eligible after 90 days, with company matching to help you invest in your future.

  • Disability Coverage

Both short- and long-term disability insurance provided at no cost to our employees.

  • Flexible PTO

Take time off when you need it, no accruing time necessary.

  • Field-Based Employee Benefits

For eligible field-based roles that require travel, Divcon covers all business travel expenses and provides a per diem, phone allowance, tools, and PPE at no cost. Eligible employees also receive paid training and additional reimbursable business expenses.

Divcon does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Agencies must have a signed agreement in place prior to submitting any candidate. Unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Divcon, and no fees will be paid.

Shiji is a global technology company dedicated to providing innovative solutions for the hospitality industry, ensuring seamless operations for hoteliers day and night.

That’s why the best hotels run on Shiji—day and night. While its primary focus is on hospitality, Shiji also serves select customers in food service, retail, and entertainment in certain regions.

The best hotels run on Shiji—day and night.

Your Role

The Sales Operations Manager plays a critical role in enabling the performance, productivity, and operational excellence of Shiji's sales organization across the Americas. Serving as a strategic operational partner, this role equips sales leaders and teams with the systems, processes, reporting, forecasting, and actionable insights needed to execute consistently execution and make informed business decisions.

Working closely with Sales leadership, Marketing, and cross-functional teams, the Sales Operations Manager owns and continuously improves CRM administration, pipeline management, forecasting, reporting, dashboards, and sales performance analysis. This role identifies opportunities to streamline processes, strengthen pipeline visibility and operational discipline, and leverage automation and AI enabled workflows so sales teams can spend more time on customer-facing activities.

What You Will Do

  • Own and continuously improve sales operations processes across the Americas, supporting sales leadership and teams throughout the region.

  • Own sales forecasting processes and reporting cadences, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and visibility into pipeline health and expected revenue performance.
  • Analyze sales and business data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights that support informed decision-making.

raw.description:
Highlights:

Location: Remote (CET hours preferred)

Language: Russian-speaking team

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB. The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React, with nearly all code written in TypeScript. For high-throughput messaging and background processing, we use Kafka (for millions of events) and Bull (Redis). Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse, and we use Elasticsearch for search.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Many of our developers bring 5 - 10+ years of experience, and we foster a culture of deep technical curiosity and knowledge sharing.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About the Role

As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will be a key contributor to our core product, building and scaling features that are central to the donation experience for millions of users. You'll leverage your expertise in Node.js, React, and TypeScript to develop complex components—from dynamic donation widgets to data-driven admin dashboards—with a relentless focus on code quality, scalability, and user experience.

This is an ideal opportunity if you love solving real-world problems at scale and want to grow within a mission-driven, high-impact engineering culture.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain resilient frontend and backend features using React and Node.js.
  • Develop our core products, including donation checkouts, embeddable widgets, and donor/partner portals.
  • Architect and develop system components that scale across millions of monthly transactions.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and thoroughly testable code.
  • Drive architecture and technical design discussions to find elegant solutions to complex problems.
  • Mentor peers by conducting thoughtful code reviews and providing constructive feedback.
  • Partner with product managers and designers to clarify requirements and shape the roadmap.
  • Proactively identify and resolve bugs, performance bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities.
  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work and understand where it adds value and how it can improve the way you operate.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional fullstack development experience.
  • Deep understanding of modern JavaScript (event loop, closures, promises, prototypes).
  • Expert-level proficiency with React and its ecosystem (familiarity with Vue is a plus).
  • Strong backend expertise with Node.js (experience with Koa or NestJS is highly preferred).
  • Experience with Webpack configuration, performance optimization, and profiling.
  • A keen eye for detail and a high sense of ownership and accountability for your work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with MongoDB, ClickHouse, or Elasticsearch.
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or a strong personal portfolio.

Bonus points

  • Curiosity and a hypothesis-driven mindset.
  • Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Comfort working in fast-paced, data-rich environments.

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds.
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders.
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people.
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next.
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is: $3,800 - $5,100 gross per month.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and alignment with the role's requirements.

Benefits

  • 31 days off.
  • 100% paid telemedicine plan.
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • English learning courses.
  • Relevant professional education.
  • Gym or swimming pool.
  • Co-working.
  • Remote working.

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose.

Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.

Position Summary
The Senior Strategic Solutions Manager is responsible for leading the business solution and contracting strategy in assigned area. This includes effectively managing the account priorities for proactive business solutions with their Operational Solutions Manager and successfully achieving the business solutions and contracting strategy with complex and system accounts. This is a cross-functional role that requires the collaboration of several Caris departments, and the Senior Strategic Solutions Manager must run point in their area to provide high-level solutions and meaningful outcomes to their customers.

  • Build partnerships with decision makers within laboratory and hospital administration to achieve meaningful business solution outcomes.
  • Effectively develop and present business and contracting strategies and proposals aligned to organizational and customer needs with consideration to ROI and ASP.
  • Lead and facilitate meetings in-person or virtually.
  • Negotiate complex contract terms and pricing to deliver solutions for Caris’ portfolio of offerings with a wide range of customers including Hospital Systems, GPOs and IDN’s.
  • Ensure compliance with internal governance requirements and statutory pricing regulations.
  • Effectively manage competing contract priorities from initiation through post-execution to include establishing optimized contract workflows and term adherence.
  • Maintain communication with legal team on contracting redlines and terms.
  • Strategically collaborate with commercial team on complex, high-impact accounts to include Strategic Accounts and Regional Business Directors.
  • Responsible for driving the LEADS/LAGS to include leading the priorities and activities of all business solutions in the Area.
  • Identify and develop training and ongoing development opportunities for team and new hires.

Job Description:

Title:M&A Paralegal

Work Mode:Fully remote for candidates located in Florida, Georgia, or South Carolina. Monthly travel required to Longwood, FL| Requirements:2–5 years of paralegal experience

Please note: If this position is posted as either fully remote and/or hybrid, in accordance with company policy, individuals residing within a 50-mile radius of a branch location may be required to work onsite in a hybrid capacity as there may be occasions when on-site presence is necessary to meet specific business needs. Additionally, our remote work policy includes having a dedicated, distraction-free workspace. Remote work is not a substitute for childcare, elder care, or other personal responsibilities during working hours. To view our branch locations, please visit: ioausa.com/locations

About the Role: The M&A Paralegal is responsible for providing legal, transactional, and compliance support to the Legal Department and M&A team, with a primary focus on acquisition activity, entity management, and insurance agency operations. This role supports transaction documentation, contract administration, corporate governance, licensing activities, regulatory compliance, and post-close integration efforts. Working closely with Legal, Compliance, HR, Risk Management, Finance, Operations, outside counsel, and acquisition partners, the M&A Paralegal helps ensure transactions and legal processes are executed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Transaction Support:Support M&A transactions by maintaining deal checklists, coordinating execution packages, managing closing activities, and tracking post-closing deliverables.

  • Contract & Document Management:Draft, review, route, track, and maintain legal agreements, contract repositories, templates, version controls, and audit-ready documentation.

  • Corporate Governance:Prepare and maintain entity registrations, annual reports, corporate resolutions, governance records, and related filings for existing and acquired entities.

  • Licensing & Regulatory Support:Assist with agency licensing, renewals, appointments, entity changes, regulatory filings, and compliance-related activities.

  • Legal Research & Regulatory Monitoring:Research insurance regulations, licensing requirements, and industry compliance standards while monitoring regulatory changes and communicating key updates.

  • Claims & Litigation Coordination:Support E&O claims, litigation holds, subpoenas, carrier inquiries, discovery requests, and regulatory notices while tracking deadlines and responses.

  • Compliance & Audit Support:Assist with internal audits, compliance reviews, risk management initiatives, and supporting documentation requirements.

  • Reporting & Communication:Prepare reports, summaries, correspondence, briefings, and presentation materials for Legal, M&A, and executive leadership teams.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:Partner with Legal, Compliance, Finance, HR, Operations, outside counsel, and acquisition stakeholders to support transactions and business objectives.

  • Project Coordination:Support legal and M&A projects through meeting coordination, agenda preparation, document distribution, and action-item tracking.

  • Process Improvement:Identify and implement improvements tolegal,compliance, contract management, and transaction support processes.

  • Technical & Professional Development:Maintain current knowledge of legal procedures, insurance regulations, corporate governance practices, and M&A best practices.

  • Champion IOA Values:Demonstrate integrity, leadership, accountability, and professionalism in all interactions.

Ideal CandidateQualifications:

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’sdegree, equivalent experience, or Paralegal certification preferred

  • 2–5 years of paralegal experience within insurance, financial services, corporate law, or another regulated industry

  • Experience supporting M&A transactions, due diligence, corporate governance, compliance, or post-close integration activities preferred

  • Strong understanding of legal terminology, contract administration, regulatory compliance, and insurance licensing processes

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities

  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and with external partners

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and contract or document management systems

  • Demonstrated discretion, integrity, and professionalism when handling confidential and privileged information

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salaries and bonus potential

  • Company-paid health insurance

  • Paid holidays, vacations, and sick time

  • 401K with employer match

  • Professional growth and career progression opportunities

  • Respectful culture and work/family life balance

  • Community service commitment

  • Supportive teammates and a rewarding work environment

What to Expect(Application Process):

  • 30-Minute Phone Screen, Online Assessments, and Interview(s).

Salary Range

The expected pay range for this position is $135,000 to $150,000 per year, depending on experience, relevant skills, and geographic location.

raw.description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics and accelerated computing for three decades. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. Doing what has never been done before takes vision, innovation, and exceptional talent. As an NVIDIAN, you will be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to do their best work and make a lasting impact on the world.

We are looking for a Solutions Architect in the Greater London area to work with academia and research partners. Solutions Architects are the primary technical contacts for our customers and engage deeply with researchers and application developers to drive the adoption of NVIDIA technology. We seek an individual who combines an intricate understanding of Multimodal AI and Physical AI with expertise in accelerated computing and architecture.

What you will be doing:

  • Partner directly with leading research labs, researchers, and university faculty as a trusted technical advisor: develop a keen understanding of their scientific goals and drive joint research projects at supercomputing scale.

  • Identify and accelerate high-impact workloads by integrating NVIDIA's frameworks, libraries, and core software stack into research projects, and help researchers amplify their impact through publications, conference presentations, and technical content.

  • Advocate for accelerated computing, robotics, Multimodal AI and Physical AI, and deliver hands-on trainings, workshops, lectures and demonstrations across NVIDIA's platforms, and mentor power users to become NVIDIA champions.

  • Track emerging research trends and turn gaps between researcher needs and NVIDIA's offerings into prototypical solutions and direct feedback to NVIDIA Engineering.

  • Maintain deep expertise in your domain while staying versatile across NVIDIA's full platform: GPUs, CPUs, networking, and software

What we need to see:

  • A graduate degree from a leading university in a STEM related discipline.

  • 5+ years in the multimodal and world model lifecycle on multi-node GPU systems: video and image data curation at scale, pre-training and post-training, evaluation, and efficient inference.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with academic and research stakeholders, and to communicate complex ideas clearly to both expert and non-expert audiences.

  • Action oriented, analytical, self-motivated, and a passionate learner, with excellent organization skills to work in a heavily multi-tasked environment.

  • Fluent in English, both oral and written, and comfortable working in Python.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • A PhD from a leading university in a STEM related discipline, with 3+ years of research in the domain.

  • A track record of thought leadership: high-impact publications, talks at academic conferences and workshops, as well as good understanding of scientific policy engagement, grant processes, or national/European research program structures.

  • Experience with NVIDIA's stack for visual and multimodal AI, built on CUDA and CUDA-X, including Cosmos world foundation models, NeMo Framework and Megatron for multimodal model training, multimodal Nemotron methodology, Isaac robotics platform, NuRec for neural reconstruction, TensorRT and NIM for deployment, and domain frameworks such as MONAI for medical imaging.

As a Solutions Architect, there is travel involved, as often the best way to figure things out is a face-toface meeting, but the job is not life on the road. We make heavy use of conferencing tools, and you are empowered to figure out how to get the job done and do what it takes to make our customers successful.

Headquartered in Toronto and with team members across the US, Open Farm is one of the fastest growing CPG companies in North America. We believe that the best foods are made with consciously sourced, top-quality ingredients from farmers and fisheries who believe in doing good for all animals and the environment.

Role Description:

Reporting to the Regional Director of Sales, a Territory Sales Manager plays a key role in driving sales performance, accelerating market expansion, and building brand presence in both existing and new territories. We're seeking an exceptional candidate responsible for executing strategies that grow Open Farm's retail footprint in Northern California. The focus will be to strengthen relationships with key accounts and retailers, and ensure our products are well represented and top-of-mind for consumers in the retail space.

A Territory Sales Manager directly contributes to the company's overall growth by identifying new business opportunities, optimizing sales channels, and executing sales and retail initiatives that enhance visibility and market share across the region. A Territory Sales Manager also act as a brand ambassador - inspiring retailers, distributors, and cusotmers alike to champion Open Farm's mission and products.

Responsibilities:

Sales Optimization

  • Drive Territory Growth: Consistently meet and exceed sales targets by implementing strategic initiatives that fuel revenue growth and strengthen Open Farm’s market position.
  • Strategic Forecasting & Planning: Develop forward-looking territory plans grounded in data, insights, and market trends to ensure alignment with company goals and long-term growth strategies.
  • Effective Budget Stewardship: Manage budgets related to travel, promotions, and customer engagement with a focus on maximizing ROI and supporting impactful growth initiatives.

Customer Focus

  • Build Meaningful Partnerships: Cultivate deep, trust-based relationships with retailers, distributors, and key partners, becoming their go-to resource for driving mutual success.
  • Customer Relationship Management: Engage consistently with accounts through store visits and ongoing communication to strengthen loyalty and advocacy for the Open Farm brand.
  • Empower Through Education: Deliver compelling product and brand training sessions that inspire confidence, deepen product knowledge, and equip partners to effectively champion Open Farm in-store.
  • Solutions-Oriented Mindset: Address challenges with empathy, urgency, and creativity, collaborating cross-functionally to deliver solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and business outcomes.

Business Development & Operations

  • Expand Our Footprint: Identify and capture new business opportunities through proactive prospecting, relationship building, and strategic networking.
  • Champion the Brand: Collaborate with marketing and retail partners to execute engaging promotional programs, events, and in-store activations that bring the Open Farm story to life.
  • Insights-Driven Performance: Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and customer feedback to uncover opportunities and provide actionable insights that inform strategic decisions.
  • Integrity in Action: Uphold Open Farm’s values by ensuring all sales and marketing activities reflect our commitment to ethics, transparency, and excellence.

Required Experience and Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in sales or territory management; experience in the pet industry is an asset.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive growth, exceed targets, and expand market presence.
  • A track record of developing and executing effective sales strategies that deliver measurable results and strengthen brand impact.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills that foster trust, collaboration, and long-term partnerships with customers and colleagues alike.
  • A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and is motivated to make a meaningful impact every day.
  • Outstanding time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance multiple initiatives and deliver consistently high-quality results.
  • A team player who values connection, feedback, and shared success while taking ownership of individual goals.
  • A proactive, positive attitude paired with a genuine passion for pets, the planet, and Open Farm’s purpose-driven mission.
  • Competence in Excel, PowerPoint, and sales reporting systems to support data-driven territory management.

Territory and Travel Requirements

This role demands a high level of flexibility, mobility, and commitment to in-person relationship building. The Territory Sales Manager works primarily in the field, requiring regular travel and a proactive, hands-on approach to driving results through in-person retailer communication and store visits.

The Territory Sales Manager (TSM) position requires flexible work arrangements, including occasional evenings and weekends, with a minimum of 20 in-person retail store visits per week and up to 60% overnight travel within the assigned territory. The territory includes Northern California.

A TSM is required to hold a valid driver’s license; reliable transportation and the ability to travel extensively are essential for success in this role.

A TSM is typically a remote position, and employees must reside within the assigned territory to effectively manage regional relationships and opportunities. Territories may be reassigned at the discretion of the Company.
